name: What are the benefits of choosing engineered hardwood over solid hardwood flooring?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of choosing engineered hardwood over solid hardwood flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Engineered hardwood offers several advantages over solid hardwood, particularly in areas with fluctuating humidity like parts of the Bay Area. Its layered construction, with a real wood veneer over a plywood core, makes it more stable and less prone to expanding, contracting, or warping. This stability allows it to be installed in basements or over concrete slabs, which is often not recommended for solid hardwood. While it can be refinished, it typically has fewer refinishing cycles than solid hardwood depending on the thickness of its wear layer.
acceptedAnswer.description: Engineered hardwood is more stable and moisture-resistant than solid hardwood, making it suitable for diverse environments and installation over concrete, though it typically offers fewer refinishes.
